obligations.label: for each month of the plan year that an enrollee participates, the enrollee may elect the monthly cap arrangement and the sponsor determines the applicable monthly cap
the sponsor determines the maximum monthly cap for each month an enrollee is participating, and monthly billing may not exceed that cap
first month of participation: the monthly cap equals the annual OOP threshold minus incurred costs, divided by the number of months remaining in the plan year including the current month
first month, clause (A): the calculation applies when the out-of-pocket costs incurred in the month are less than the maximum monthly cap defined in this paragraph
first month, clause (B): the calculation applies when the individual opts in before the start of the plan year

subsequent months: the monthly cap equals the sum of amounts still owed from an earlier month but not yet billed, plus any additional out-of-pocket costs incurred, divided by the count of months left in the plan year, current month included
eligible OOP costs are incurred costs for covered Part D drugs that count toward the annual OOP threshold
months remaining in the plan year includes the current month, determined under paragraph (c)(3)
the monthly cap election does not affect TrOOP amounts; costs under the arrangement are treated as incurred at adjudication, and amounts owed but not yet billed must not be double-counted
when an individual receives an extended day supply, costs count in the month dispensed, with the attribution mechanics of this paragraph
an individual who switches plans midyear is treated under the first month of participation rules
